registration_mechanism: This file is committed. The commit hash of the commit that introduced or last changed a strategy is that strategy's registration. Rules are never edited to fit a result; a change means a new strategy id.
leaderboard_rule: No number produced by the backtest corpus may appear on the leaderboard. The leaderboard reads scores.json only, and its payload is asserted at build time.

strategies.name: Opponent-adjusted side
strategies.rule: Bet the side when the E1 opponent-adjusted fair spread differs from the market spread by at least 2.5 points, on the side the model prefers.
strategies.rationale: The simplest test of whether opponent adjustment carries information.

G1-data.detail: price store and model inputs present and hashed

demotion_gate.rule: A live strategy returns to paper when, over its last 100 prospective bets, the game-cluster lower bound of its Brier skill against the benchmark falls to zero or below, or when its closing-line value is negative at the 95% level. Demotion is automatic and published on the leaderboard the same day.
demotion_gate.note: Nothing is live. The gate exists so that promotion has a defined reversal.

what_would_change_our_mind.toward_belief: A positive game-cluster lower bound on BSS over at least 1,000 prospective games, holding after multiplicity adjustment.
what_would_change_our_mind.away_from_belief: A lower bound at or below zero over 100 consecutive prospective bets, or a documented data fault in its inputs.

strategies.name: Unadjusted season-average side
strategies.rule: Bet the side when the E2 season-average fair spread differs from the market spread by at least 2.5 points.
strategies.rationale: Control for S1: if the naive estimator does as well, adjustment is not the value.

strategies.name: Moneyline value
strategies.rule: Bet the moneyline side when model P(win) exceeds the vig-free implied probability by at least 4 percentage points.
strategies.rationale: The one market where both estimators cleared a benchmark in validation.

strategies.name: Side + total same-game parlay
strategies.rule: Combine S1 and S3 only when a directly validated JOINT probability exists; never multiply the two marginal probabilities.
strategies.rationale: The brief's parlay rule: marginal multiplication is invalid under dependence.
strategies.blocked_reason: No validated joint probability distribution exists for the joint event. The measured margin/total correlation is near zero, which makes the multiplication approximately valid for THAT pair, but 'approximately valid' is not the same as 'directly validated'.

strategies.name: Player prop combination
strategies.rule: Combine player prop markets only with validated joint probabilities and operator void rules.
strategies.rationale: The brief asks for prop combos to be considered, not to be assumed feasible.
strategies.blocked_reason: No player-level price data exists in this repository's verified sources, so neither a marginal nor a joint probability can be validated. The division is registered as blocked rather than omitted.

strategies.name: Availability ablation, side
strategies.rule: Identical side model run twice, with and without verified availability features, on chronological holdouts; report the difference with uncertainty.
strategies.rationale: Replaces a fixed points penalty for a missing starter with a measured ablation.
strategies.blocked_reason: Requires availability snapshots that are pre-kickoff for the games in the test window. The repository holds one capture per week, taken after most of that week's games had kicked off, so the ablation cannot yet be run without lookahead. See availability.json.
